Package loveletter.model

Class Game

java.lang.Object
loveletter.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Manages the participants and lifecycle of a Love Letter game.

    • startNextRound

      public void startNextRound()
      Creates the next round after the current round has been scored, provided the game is not over.

      The winner of the previous round becomes the starting player. If multiple players won, the first winner in participant order becomes the starting player.

      This method creates the round but does not start its first turn.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the game has not started, the current round has not been scored, or the game is already over
